title: An overview of unit and integration testing and the use of mocks

videos.script: Under every screen you test there are pieces of code, and some of them have tests of their own. {{layers}} A unit test checks one small piece, alone, in a thousandth of a second. {{unit}} An integration test checks that the pieces work together. {{integration}} You will not write these for a living. But you will work beside the people who do, and their results change where your time goes. {{beside}} In this lesson you run three short test files against boxoffice 1.1. {{files}} The first calls the discount function directly, and finds the student regression of lesson 10 from below. {{discount}} The second books through the running application, and finds it again, in reais. {{booking}} The third replaces the e-mail code with a mock, and checks the conversation instead of the result. {{mock}} And you start boxoffice with a fake clock, to test half past seven in the evening at two in the afternoon. {{clock}} Every stand-in is a claim about the real thing. Knowing what was replaced is half of reading a green test run. {{claim}}
